brand.name: Tau Ceti Labs
brand.description: Tau Ceti Labs is an independent studio building science-minded games and tabletop experiments with engineering at the core.

hero.title: Games from the far workbench.
hero.body: Tau Ceti Labs builds playable systems around science, materials, movement, pressure, and repair, as if the notes were coming back from a bright, messy lab a dozen light years away.

projects.name: LithoBreak
projects.summary: Wake the console and build the first foothold on a hostile moon. LithoBreak is being rebuilt in public around a smaller, clearer first-site loop.

projects.name: Tau Ceti RaceCards
projects.summary: A tabletop racing game in development, playable now as a print-and-play kit, with a premium physical version planned.

principles: Build small systems that make readable pressure.
Prefer honest current-state claims over future-tense spectacle.
Let product sites carry product depth; keep the company hub clear.

gameRoom.title: Game Room
gameRoom.body: A future /play area can host small web games, prototypes, and science toys once the main lab terminal is stable.

subscribe.title: Company updates
subscribe.body: Occasional Tau Ceti Labs updates about studio releases, project launches, and public experiments. Product-specific updates remain separate.
